# temps_analytics_traffic_filter (Resource)

Excludes visits from a project's analytics: those from a referrer domain (and its subdomains), an IP address or range, a network (ASN) or a country. Changing it replaces the filter.

Import with `<project_id>/<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `analytics:read`, `analytics:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_analytics_traffic_filter" "spam" {
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
  kind       = "referrer"
  value      = "spam-site.example"
  note       = "Referral spam"
}

resource "temps_analytics_traffic_filter" "office" {
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
  kind       = "ip"
  value      = "203.0.113.0/24"
  note       = "Our own office"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) What the filter matches. One of `referrer`, `ip`, `asn`, `country`.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.
- `value` (String) A domain or URL (`referrer`), an IP address or CIDR range (`ip`), a network number with or without `AS` (`asn`), or a two-letter country code (`country`). Temps stores it normalized, in `normalized_value`. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

### Optional

- `note` (String) Why the filter exists.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id>/<id>`.
- `normalized_value` (String) The value as Temps matches it, for example `spam.example` for `https://www.spam.example/x`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<id>. Temps returns the value normalized, so set value in configuration again after importing.
terraform import temps_analytics_traffic_filter.spam 8/17
```
